# YouTube Transcript API Reference

The base URL for every endpoint below is `https://transcript-yt.com`. Grab a key from your [dashboard](https://transcript-yt.com/dashboard/keys) first. A machine-readable [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://transcript-yt.com/openapi.json) is available for code generation and agent tooling.

## Quickstart

Create a key, then request a transcript by URL or video ID:

```
curl "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/transcript?url=5f3Pn-N6yLc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx"
```

## AI agents (MCP)

Connect TranscriptYT to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, or Claude Desktop through our MCP server at `https://transcript-yt.com/mcp`. The one-click installs sign you in; in the snippets below, replace `ts_live_...` with your key.

```
claude mcp add --transport http transcriptyt https://transcript-yt.com/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_..."
```

Your agent gets six tools:

- `get_transcript`: transcript by URL or ID, with optional `language`, `translate_to`, `format` (defaults to `md`), and `timestamps`. 1 credit.
- `summarize_video`: summary, key points, and timestamped notes from a video's transcript. 2 credits for most videos, more for long ones.
- `list_languages`: available caption tracks. Free.
- `list_playlist_videos`: videos in a playlist or a channel's uploads. Free on paid plans; Free plan: 10 a day, then 1 credit.
- `search_youtube`: search YouTube, or within one channel. Free on paid plans; Free plan: 10 a day, then 1 credit.
- `get_usage`: remaining credits. Free.

## Authentication

Pass your key as a bearer token. `x-api-key` also works if a header library makes that easier.

```
Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

## GET /v1/transcript

Fetch a transcript for any public YouTube video.

| Param | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| url | string, required | A YouTube URL (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed) or a bare 11-char video ID. |
| language | string, optional | BCP-47 code (e.g. `es`, `pt-BR`). Defaults to the original / English track. If the video has no track in that language, the original is machine-translated into it and `translated` is `true`. |
| translate_to | string, optional | BCP-47 target code, any of 150+ languages. Machine-translates whichever track`language` selects, keeping every segment's timing. The response's `language`becomes the target and `translated` is `true`. |
| format | string, optional | `json` (default), `text`, `srt`, `vtt`,`csv`, or `md`. |
| includeSegments | boolean, optional | Set `false` to drop the timestamped array and return only full text (JSON format only). |
| timestamps | boolean, optional | Set `true` to prefix each line with a `[HH:MM:SS]` marker in`text` and `md` output. Formatting is free, with no extra credit cost. |
| paragraphs | boolean, optional | Set `true` to merge segments into paragraph-length chunks (on speech pauses or a character budget) instead of raw caption cues. |
| chunkSize | integer, optional | With `paragraphs=true`, the maximum characters per paragraph (50 to 10000, default 400). |
| captionType | string, optional | `any` (default), `manual` for uploaded captions only, or `auto` for YouTube's auto-generated captions only. |
| originalLanguage | boolean, optional | Set `true` to get captions in the language actually spoken instead of the English track. Ignored when `language` is set. |
| mode | string, optional | `auto` (default) uses captions and falls back to AI transcription. `captions` never uses AI. `ai` transcribes the audio even when captions exist (billed per minute). AI transcription needs a paid plan or credit pack; on the Free plan `ai` returns 403 `PLAN_REQUIRED` and `auto` reads captions only. |
| startTime / endTime | number, optional | Seconds. Return only the part of the transcript in this range. |
| search | string, optional | Return only the lines containing this text (case-insensitive), each with its timestamp. |

Also available as `POST /v1/transcript` with a JSON body of the same shape.

```
curl "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/transcript?url=https://youtu.be/5f3Pn-N6yLc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx"
```

```
{
  "videoId": "5f3Pn-N6yLc",
  "title": "How To Clean Up Gmail Inbox - Fast and Easily",
  "author": "Tech is Easy",
  "channelId": "UCu7hJvEMoy36jfbJXp6heRg",
  "durationSeconds": 151,
  "language": "en",
  "translated": false,
  "autoGenerated": true,
  "source": "captions",
  "segments": [
    { "start": 0.24, "duration": 3.84, "end": 4.08, "timestamp": "0:00", "text": "in the next two to three minutes I'm" },
    { "start": 2.159, "duration": 3.481, "end": 5.64, "timestamp": "0:02", "text": "gonna show you how to clean up your" }
  ],
  "text": "in the next two to three minutes I'm gonna show you how to clean up your ...",
  "availableLanguages": [
    { "languageCode": "en", "languageName": "English (auto-generated)", "autoGenerated": true }
  ]
}
```

## POST /v1/transcripts

Many videos in one call: 10 on Free, 25 on Micro, 50 on Starter, 200 on Growth, 500 on Scale. Send `urls` plus any of the options above; each video is billed and rate-limited like a single request, and one failure doesn't fail the batch. Videos beyond your per-minute rate limit come back as `RATE_LIMITED`items to retry.

```
curl -X POST "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/transcripts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"urls": ["5f3Pn-N6yLc", "https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ"], "format": "text"}'
```

```
{
  "total": 2, "succeeded": 2, "failed": 0,
  "results": [
    { "url": "5f3Pn-N6yLc", "ok": true, "cached": true, "body": "in the next two to three minutes..." },
    ...
  ]
}
```

JSON-format items carry a `transcript` object; other formats carry the file as `body`.

**A whole playlist or channel.** Send `playlist` (a playlist link or ID, or a channel link or `@handle`) instead of `urls`, with an optional `limit` (up to your plan's batch size). Channels return their newest uploads first.

```
curl -X POST "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/transcripts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"playlist": "https://www.youtube.com/@mkbhd", "limit": 10, "format": "md"}'
```

## GET /v1/playlist

List the videos in a playlist, or a channel's uploads, without fetching any transcripts. Free on paid plans and credit packs; on the Free plan, the first 10 uncached lookups a day are free, then each costs 1 credit. `limit` defaults to 100 (max 500).

```
curl "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/playlist?url=@mkbhd&limit=3" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx"
```

```
{
  "kind": "channel",
  "id": "UUBJycsmduvYEL83R_U4JriQ",
  "title": "Marques Brownlee",
  "videos": [
    { "videoId": "...", "title": "...", "durationSeconds": 742 },
    ...
  ],
  "truncated": true
}
```

## GET /v1/search

Search YouTube for videos, or pass `channel` (a channel link or `@handle`) to search within one channel. Free on paid plans and credit packs; on the Free plan, the first 10 uncached searches and playlist lookups a day are free, then each costs 1 credit. `limit` defaults to 20 (max 100).

```
curl "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/search?q=iphone&channel=@mkbhd&limit=2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx"
```

```
{
  "query": "iphone",
  "channelId": "UCBJycsmduvYEL83R_U4JriQ",
  "videos": [
    {
      "videoId": "...",
      "title": "...",
      "channelTitle": "Marques Brownlee",
      "channelId": "UCBJycsmduvYEL83R_U4JriQ",
      "durationSeconds": 1034,
      "viewCount": 27507991,
      "published": "3 weeks ago"
    },
    ...
  ],
  "truncated": true
}
```

## GET /v1/summary

Summary, key points, and timestamped study notes for a video, generated from its transcript. Written in the transcript's language; `translate_to` summarizes a translated transcript instead. Costs 1 credit for the transcript plus the summary's AI cost: 1 credit for videos up to about 25 minutes and for already-cached summaries, about 1 more per further 45 minutes of speech. Most requests cost 2 credits; `X-Credits-Charged` shows the total.

```
curl "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/summary?url=5f3Pn-N6yLc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx"
```

```
{
  "videoId": "5f3Pn-N6yLc",
  "title": "...",
  "author": "...",
  "language": "en",
  "cached": { "transcript": true, "summary": false },
  "summary": "...",
  "keyPoints": ["...", "..."],
  "notes": [
    { "start": 42, "heading": "...", "bullets": ["...", "..."] },
    ...
  ]
}
```

## GET /v1/languages

List available caption tracks for a video without downloading one, plus every language `translateTo` accepts. This call does not cost a credit.

```
curl "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/languages?url=5f3Pn-N6yLc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx"
```

```
{
  "videoId": "5f3Pn-N6yLc",
  "languages": [
    { "languageCode": "en", "languageName": "English (auto-generated)", "autoGenerated": true }
  ],
  "translationLanguages": [
    { "languageCode": "af", "languageName": "Afrikaans" },
    ...
  ]
}
```

## Output formats

`format=srt`, `format=vtt`, `format=csv`, and`format=md` return files directly with a matching `Content-Type`. Pipe the response straight to a file. Every format is generated from the same underlying transcript at no extra credit cost, including `timestamps` and `paragraphs`.

**Videos with no captions.** When a video has no caption track, we transcribe its audio with AI speech-to-text. **AI transcription covers videos up to 9 hours long**; a longer caption-less video returns `NO_CAPTIONS` with `details.too_long: true` and costs nothing. The response has `source: "speech_to_text"` and `autoGenerated: true`, and costs 1 credit per started minute of audio (see the `X-Credits-Charged` header). Repeat requests for the same video are cache hits and cost 1 credit. `language` and `translate_to` work the same way on these transcripts. AI transcription is available on paid plans and credit packs; Free accounts get captions only, and a caption-less video returns `NO_CAPTIONS`.

```
curl "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/transcript?url=5f3Pn-N6yLc&format=srt" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx" -o captions.srt
```

## GET /v1/usage

Current plan, credit balance (plan + top-up), and rate limit. Free, never costs a credit.

```
curl "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/usage" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx"
```

```
{
  "plan": "STARTER",
  "credits_remaining": 3820,
  "plan_credits": { "total": 4000, "used": 180, "remaining": 3820 },
  "topup_credits": { "remaining": 0, "grants": [] },
  "period_resets_at": "2026-10-19T00:00:00.000Z",
  "rate_limit_per_minute": 200
}
```

## Errors

Every error uses the same envelope, except 402 (see below):

```
{ "error": { "code": "NO_CAPTIONS", "message": "This video has no captions available." } }
```

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| INVALID_VIDEO | 400 | Couldn't parse a video ID from the given url |
| VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE | 404 | Video is private, deleted, or region-locked |
| NO_CAPTIONS | 404 | Video has no captions and its audio could not be AI-transcribed: over 9 hours long (details.too_long), audio unavailable, or Free plan (captions only) |
| PLAN_REQUIRED | 403 | mode=ai on the Free plan; AI transcription needs a paid plan or credit pack |
| LANGUAGE_NOT_AVAILABLE | 404 | Requested language isn't offered |
| UNAUTHORIZED | 401 | Missing or invalid API key |
| RATE_LIMITED | 429 | Too many requests per minute |
| BLOCKED | 503 | Temporary upstream block. Retry shortly. |

Out of credits is a 402 with its own flat shape rather than the error envelope above:

```
{
  "error": "Out of credits",
  "plan": "MICRO",
  "credits_remaining": 0,
  "upgrade_url": "https://transcript-yt.com/dashboard/billing",
  "topup_url": "https://transcript-yt.com/dashboard/billing#topup"
}
```

Failed requests (any 4xx/5xx from us) are never billed a credit.

## Rate limits & credits

Every response carries usage headers so you can back off before hitting a wall. A 429 also carries `Retry-After` (seconds):

```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 200
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 197
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1737403200
Retry-After: 12
X-Credits-Charged: 1
X-Credits-Remaining: 3786
```

`X-Credits-Charged` is the credits billed for that call (including cache hits) and 0 on any failure. `X-Credits-Remaining` is your plan balance plus any purchased top-up or pack credits. See the [pricing page](https://transcript-yt.com/#pricing) for per-plan limits.
